construction: Supported protected Brain constructor receives configured memories/sensors, empty initial activities, packed memories, entity random; matches Provider.makeBrain bytecode. Full activities installed afterward by BehaviourConfigurationContext.
native_lifecycle: PokemonEntity and NPCEntity override makeBrain(Brain.Packed); NPC returns the final configured instance to vanilla. Legacy Dynamic callers retained through registry-aware codec adapters.
live_reconfiguration: Brain.Visitor snapshots all present runtime values and their expiry, including types with no disk codec. Native Brain.pack() intentionally excludes those types; disk saves continue to use native pack.
activity_contract: Native four-argument addActivity retains task weights, original memory conditions and no erase-on-stop entries. Growing crop still requires LOOK_TARGET VALUE_PRESENT.
schedule: Former immutable Schedule.EMPTY selected no timetable; nullable EnvironmentAttribute<Activity> leaves native schedule unset. Explicit custom core/default/manual activity selection retained.
source_compatibility: Addon MoLangScriptingEntity implementors must implement Packed overload; old Dynamic callers remain supported. Public schedule type changes to EnvironmentAttribute<Activity>? for target API.
scripted_nbt: VariableStruct data/config roots are explicitly required nonnull before put; generic writer continues filtering unsupported child values exactly as before.
tests: 127 focused assertions total against production helpers and real game classes; includes runtime-only LOOK_TARGET identity, UUID/TTL, sensors, activity transition and strict malformed-data refusal.
limits: No actual NPC/Pokemon initialization or AI tick in a Minecraft process
Full entity lifecycle, navigation, rendering and movement remain unported
Existing behavior scripts and full legacy worlds not exercised
Strict malformed dynamic brain decode throws rather than silently resetting memories
